# ScrollDirection

`Flare.Components.ScrollDirection`

Which way a scroll container moved between two notifications. One enum for both axes: a vertical reading only ever yields None, Up or Down, and a horizontal one only None, Left or Right.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | No movement on this axis since the previous notification. |
| `Up` | `1` | Moved toward the start - the reader is going back up. |
| `Down` | `2` | Moved toward the end - the reader is going down. |
| `Left` | `3` | Moved back toward the leading horizontal edge. |
| `Right` | `4` | Moved on toward the trailing horizontal edge. |
